fixes: Teacher evaluation defaults to source audit seed, with explicit override; missing seed requires explicit selection.
EcoLight phase projection rejects input/output alias and existing destination, publishes atomically, cleans partial files, rejects empty/header-only input.
Deployment bias indices must be canonical nonnegative integers; unknown intersection/phase indices are rejected rather than ignored.
Teacher evaluation, student evaluation and trajectory collection reject output paths that overwrite their source inputs.
Student evaluation closes isolated policy process even on failure.
limits: Source replay tests use previously generated deterministic fixture policies, not new LLM searches.
48 tests and six replays cannot prove absence of all bugs or all-state traffic safety.
Paired comparisons must explicitly use the same simulation seed when collection used a custom seed different from training.
Earlier short training and module test scope remains as described in MODULE_VALIDATION.json.
